name: ui_main

name: roster_home_card_draw
notes: hook of homescrn: rank+surname, theatre, war, mission type, skill, crash, flight model, rating

name: ui_ready_room

name: ui_hangar_hook

name: ui_hangar_launch

name: ui_hangar_anim
notes: 18-frame hangar strip animation from tables 006A/0106/0136/0148, abortable

name: quiz_draw

name: quiz_run
notes: DEAD (call patched out by 3 NOPs at 001D): ID quiz, sets comm+22h

name: arm_screen_draw
notes: hook of armsscrn: bays, unavailable weapons, payload lbs, fuel

name: arm_screen_run

name: arm_hover_hook

name: arm_show_weapon_info
notes: weapon picture, name plate and description; 20 = clear

name: arm_draw_bay
notes: draw bay frame + weapon icon at bay box position

name: arm_roll_unavailable
notes: randomly flag up to 4 weapons unavailable (DS:D878)

name: arm_draw_fuel
notes: fuel lbs = 10000 (if mission) + 1900 per fuel tank bay

name: brief_setup
notes: enter briefing: reset modes, load brefscrn and theatre map, brief_new_mission

name: brief_screen_run
notes: briefing map loop (tbl 6D1E); returns 0 back, 3 to arming

name: brief_hover_hook
notes: hover hint text, colours and site popup for tbl 6D1E

name: brief_new_mission
notes: show brefscrn, decode mission if D2A2==0 (40F0), build site buttons, animated redraw

name: brief_redraw
notes: clean map -> icons -> route -> ranges/hostile -> blit to screen

name: brief_draw_route
notes: draw depart/target/target/land markers, texts, animated lines and T/P/S/L labels

name: brief_draw_ranges
notes: radar/SAM range rings per site button, palette-coloured

name: brief_draw_site_icons
notes: site icon sprites at site button centres

name: brief_draw_hostile
notes: hostile concentration icons from 16x16 grid CAD8 (original loop-counter bug)

name: brief_hint_text
notes: help line under the map for button h (0x64/0x65 = hostile result)

name: brief_site_info
notes: airbase/radar data popup for site button n

name: brief_build_site_buttons
notes: build dynamic site buttons (DS:6D62), B286/B287 pairs, B2E6, 6D21

name: brief_orders_screen
notes: mission orders pages (FOLDER1/FOLDER2), see shell.md part E

name: brief_draw_target_summary
notes: which 0/1 = primary/secondary: heading + intro paragraph (1F24 table) + OBJECTIVE: + objective text; caller 20d6

name: brief_format_date
notes: sprintf(buf,"%s %d, %d") of the campaign date from pilot record (theatre +38h, days +36h) and date tables 882/88C/896/8A8/8C2

name: brief_format_objective
notes: builds the one-line objective sentence for mission-objective record (E05E+12h*n); switch on type byte of 11DE table (8 kinds)

name: ui_load_file_far
notes: open + read up to FFFFh bytes to seg:off + close; returns bytes read

name: ui_load_file_near
notes: open + read up to FFFFh bytes to near buf + close

name: ui_anim_start
type: int(int src_page, RectTbl *tbl, uint8_t *seq, int nsteps)
notes: starts the button-highlight animation (returns 0 and ignores if one is running)

name: ui_anim_step
notes: per-tick step; acts every 8th call; returns remaining steps

name: ui_text_centered
type: void(TextCtx *c, char *s, int cx, int y)
notes: draws s centred on cx (text_width/2) at y via slot 5

name: ui_popup_restore_box
notes: copies saved background (page 2 at 0,h+4; size b->w,b->h at +6/+8) back to pages 1 and 0 at x,y

name: ui_wait_ticks
notes: n x pal_apply_queue (each waits one timer tick)

name: ui_popup_text
type: void(char *s, int x, int y, int font, int centre, int wrap_w)
notes: framed text popup on pages 1+0; saves background in page 2; geometry in B2F6/B2F8/B2FC/B302; undo with ui_popup_restore

name: ui_draw_frame
type: void(TextCtx *c, int x, int y, int w, int h)
notes: bevelled panel: 4 corner tiles from page 2 (0..3,0..3), edges colours E0/E6/E1/E5, fill E2 (U)

name: ui_draw_button
type: int(char *s, int cx, int y, int colour)
notes: font 1 button: frame (w=textw+8,h=16) centred on cx + shadowed text; returns w

name: map_draw_range_ring
type: void(int wx, int wy, int radius, int colour, int solid)
notes: circle of given world radius on the ONC map page 1 (dc18); dotted if solid==0

name: map_draw_route_line
type: int(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int skip)
notes: animated 6-bit DDA line on page 1 (+ screen); polls ui_wait_skip(1) each step until Space; returns skip flag

name: pal_fade
type: void(uint8_t *pal, int from, int to, int speed)
notes: quadratic brightness fade of 768-byte palette; stops timer ISR during the fade

name: pal_fade_calibrate
notes: counts pal_set calls in 4 BIOS ticks into [B304]

name: map_place_label
notes: draws s near world point p1 choosing an offset away from the segments to p2/p3 (page 1 ctx dc18)

name: ui_dialog_draw
notes: measures + draws message dialog with 1 or 2 buttons; fills d->w,h and the button hit rects (+0Eh..+1Ch)

name: pal_queue_push
notes: appends {first,rgb,count} to the DAC update queue 64A6 (count byte 64E2, max 10); applied by pal_apply_queue (8427)

name: ui_text
type: void(TextCtx *c, char *s, int x, int y)

name: ui_popup_restore
notes: undo of ui_popup_text/ui_dialog_draw background: page 2 -> pages 1 and 0 using B2F6/B2F8/B2FC/B302

name: ui_load_screen_pic
notes: loads "<CBA[name_idx]>.pic" into the file buffer, decodes into page seg CAB0[slot] with pic_to_seg_b (no palette)

name: ui_show_screen
notes: fade out, load pic into page 1, blit to screen, run overlay, fade in, screen_on

name: ui_sprite_draw
type: void(SpriteCtx *c, int x, int y, unsigned seg)
notes: slot 22 sprite_scaled at natural size (dw,dh = words 0 and 2 of seg:0)

name: ui_text_shadow
type: void(TextCtx *c, char *s, int x, int y)
notes: if c->bg != -1 draws s three times in c->bg at (x+1,y),(x,y+1),(x+1,y+1) then normally at x,y

name: ui_text_width
notes: sum of slot 47 font_char_width over s (font = c->font)

name: ui_text_wrap
type: int(TextCtx *c, char *s, int x, int y, int width, int line_h, int centre)
notes: word wrap + draw (page -1 = measure only); returns widest line; c->y ends at the next line

name: ui_menu_loop
notes: modal input loop; returns button index 1..n, 63h cancel(ignored by dialog), 100h+hotkey

name: ui_hit_test
notes: 1-based index of the 8-byte rect {x0,y0,x1,y1} containing the cursor (E08A,E08C), else 0

name: ui_cursor_erase
notes: blit_rect page1 -> page0 over the old cursor box (E08E,E090,E092 x E093)

name: ui_poll_input
notes: one poll of joystick/mouse/keyboard, moves + redraws the cursor; returns 0/1/2/62h/key

name: ui_dialog_run
notes: modal dialog: draw, place cursor on button 1, ui_menu_loop until not 63h, restore; returns 1/2/100h+key

name: ui_dialog_hover
notes: menu callback (cb field of every dialog descriptor): highlights the hovered button by swapping DAC E7/E8 colours

name: ui_cursor_init
notes: E088=seg, E092/E093 = byte0/byte2 of sprite, E094=E095=2, cursor pos and old pos = 0,0

name: ui_kbd_flush
notes: while a key is waiting: kbd_get (slots 90/91); no callers

name: ui_wait_click
notes: wait for button0/Enter (1) or button1/Esc (2); Alt-Q -> quit prompt

name: ui_wait_input
notes: wait up to ticks (0 = ~forever): 0 none, 1 button0/Enter, 2 button1/Esc, 3 Space; waits for button release first

name: ui_wait_skip
notes: ui_wait_input + click sound; returns 1 only for Space

name: mission_site_setup
notes: after theatre/pilot choice: copies pilot theatre fields, calls theatre_load(5466) + 4239, option bytes CAD2..5, scans map flag 10h, randomly flags sites 40h/80h; caller 1308

name: mission_generate
notes: mission generator: picks targets, templates, units, loadout, times

name: wld_site_at_pos
notes: snap to terrain cell, find/create site

name: wld_site_of_type
notes: find terrain object of type, find/create site

name: arm_pick_weapon
notes: best weapon row in DS:1D86, random tie

name: wld_read_file
notes: fread .WLD into DGROUP tables, builds name pointer table

name: wld_pack_get
notes: copy from far cursor B392:B390 to DS

name: wld_pack_put
notes: copy DS to far cursor B392:B390

name: map_site_grid_ref
notes: grid ref of site x,y for current theatre

name: brief_clock_string
notes: HH:MM from ticks (30 per minute), night offset from comm+33

name: ui_orders_draw
notes: orders screen setup callback (hotspot enable, palette, markers)

name: ui_orders_screen
notes: orders screen menu loop (theatre, war level, mission type, Fly)

name: ui_orders_hover
notes: menu idle callback: hover colours and tooltips

name: roster_screen_draw
notes: roster screen callback: 10 lines, highlight, delete hint

name: roster_screen_run
notes: Roster screen main loop: show rostscrn, pick pilot / Delete = rename / Done; saves roster on exit. Called from 029D.

name: roster_hover_cb
notes: menu hover callback of roster_menu (DS:704E): row colours + info panel

name: roster_draw_info
notes: bottom info panel: rank+surname, best/last mission, option strings, medals (CMH DFC AFC SS AM PH)

name: roster_draw_row
notes: draws one roster row into page 1: rank+name, score (x=224 right), missions (x=246 right), status centred; code is duplicated in the binary

name: ui_str_last_word
notes: pointer to the part after the last space (surname)

name: roster_edit_name
notes: Delete key on a row: type a new pilot name (prefix '2nd Lt ', max 29 chars, Esc cancels); resets the record and copies it to the active pilot

name: roster_startup_sync
notes: called once after shell_init: load roster, fix +3C, roster<->active copy depending on first-run word, save silently

name: roster_options_screen
notes: pilot options panel: opponent level (+3E), landing (+40), aircraft (+42); Done / right click cancel

name: roster_options_hover_cb
notes: hover callback of opt_menu (DS:6FFA): DAC 0xF5-i red/normal

name: roster_load
notes: fopen Roster.Fil rb (unchecked), read word B39C + 10 x 0x50 into D892

name: roster_save
notes: write Roster.Fil unless fcb_find()==0 (original floppy volume label F117A-SF); error boxes 72EA/729D if show_err

name: shell_init
notes: program start: comm setup, bind MISC/MGRAPHIC/sound drivers, buffers, gfx init, sprites, timer, joystick/mouse, srand

name: shell_comm_setup
notes: sets DS:CBD8 (->0000:04F2), CAC0 (->04F4), E096/E098 comm far ptr, CACA/CACC active pilot = comm+1272h

name: shell_gfx_init
notes: alloc 24000 B scratch (dup of 7312), mode13/screen_off first time, 5 pages + 5 TextCtx at DC02, load PALETTES.PAL (6912 B)

name: shell_sprites_init
notes: load requestr.pic to page 2, sprite pool, 10 sprite_grab, cursor sprite D32E

name: ui_quit_prompt
notes: Alt-Q: show adv.pic + adv.pal, Y exits, any other key restores the screen

name: shell_exit
notes: snd stop, free buffer, remove hooks, text mode if code<=1, 'Not enough memory!' if code==1, exit(code)
